idea-plugin.name: IconSearch - 355,000+ Vector Icons
idea-plugin.description:
IconSearch for JetBrains IDEs

Search, preview, and insert 355,000+ open-source vector SVG icons directly inside IntelliJ IDEA, WebStorm, PyCharm, PhpStorm, GoLand, and CLion.

✨ Features:

  • 355,000+ SVG Icons: Search Lucide, Heroicons, Tabler, FontAwesome, Remix, Phosphor, Feather, Bootstrap, and Iconify collections.
  • 1-Click Editor Insertion: Insert React JSX components (<LucideSearch className="w-5 h-5" />), raw SVG, Vue, Svelte, or Tailwind CSS masks directly into your active code.
  • License & Legal Filter: Filter commercial-safe icons instantly.
  • Secure Session Auth: 1-click device authorization saved securely in JetBrains PasswordSafe.
  • Dark & Light Mode: Auto-adapts to your IDE editor theme.
